map.分档累加：各档 (应税−下限) × 档率 使用指南: Bracket-by-Bracket Accumulation: (Taxable - Lower Limit) x Rate per Bracket User Guide
map.输入应纳税所得额并自定义各档级距下限与税率，按分档累加（各档 (应税−下限)×档: Enter taxable income and customize the lower limits and rates of each bracket, then compute progressive income tax at three or more brackets with (taxable - lower limit) x rate per bracket, for graded taxation of wages and business income.
map.3000=6000。 可改档位模拟个税/企税。: 3000=6000. The brackets can be changed to model individual or corporate tax.
map.三档累进税率下的所得税（可自定义档位与税率）。: Income tax under three progressive brackets (brackets and rates customizable).
map.将所得按级距分段适用不同税率，算应纳税额与实际税率。: Apply a different rate to each bracket split by the grade ranges, then compute the tax payable and the effective rate.
map.对比不同收入在累进下的税负跳变。: Compare the tax jump under progressive rates for different income levels.
map.验证\"多赚不多缴太多\"的边际效应。: Verify the marginal effect of earning more without paying much more tax.
map.：前 3 万仍缴 6000，超出 2 万按 30% 缴 6000，合计 1200: The first 30,000 is still taxed at 6000; the 20,000 above that is taxed at 30% for 6000, totalling 12000 CNY, so the effective rate rises to 24%.
map.税额 = 计税余值 × 税率: Tax = taxable remainder x tax rate
map.由代扣金额与征收率求代扣代缴税额: Withheld tax from the withholding amount and the levy rate
map.含税 = 价格 × (1 + 税率): Price including tax = price x (1 + tax rate)
map.由缴费基数与社保费率求社保费: Social insurance contribution from the contribution base and the rate
map.超额累进与全额累进区别？: What's the Difference Between Excess Progressive and Full Progressive?
map.超额累进仅对超出各级距的部分按高档税率，全额累进则全部所得跳档适用高档，前者更平: Excess progressive taxation applies the higher rate only to the portion above each bracket, while full progressive taxation applies the higher rate to all income once a bracket is reached; the former is smoother.
map.实际税率为什么低于最高边际税率？: Why Is the Effective Rate Below the Top Marginal Rate?
map.因低收入部分适用低档，整体平均后实际税率低于最高档边际税率。: Because the lower income portion is taxed at lower brackets, the effective rate after averaging is below the top marginal rate.
